name: codex-usage-float
description: A local macOS menu-bar monitor for recent Codex 5-hour and weekly usage snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: Keep 5-hour and weekly Codex quota remaining in your menu bar.
interface.longDescription: Builds a local macOS menu-bar utility that reads the latest Codex usage snapshot stored on this Mac. No credentials or usage data leave the device.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me launch Codex Usage Float and verify its local usage snapshot.
